validation.notes: Repaired three production defects in packages/agent/src/harness: (1) runtime/drive/tools.ts recoverToolInvocation had an unreachable replay guard `if (false && !cancelled && call.replay === "safe" && tool?.replay === "safe")`, so non-cancelled safe/safe recovery always published an interrupted result instead of replaying persisted arguments and memos; now `if (!cancelled && ...)`. (2) execution/tools.ts finalizeToolCall merged the after-tool patch with `patch?.isError || executed.isError`, so a hook could never clear isError; now `patch?.isError === undefined ? executed.isError : patch.isError`, keeping the field-by-field spread so explicit false/empty patch values (isError:false, content:[], details:{}) apply while unpatched content, details, usage and terminate are preserved. (3) execution/effect-gate.ts GateControl.close returned early unless the gate was open (`state.status !== "open"`), so closing an aborting gate was ignored and later admissions kept throwing AbortRequested tied to a pending cancellation; now only an already-closed gate short-circuits, making the terminal error authoritative for later admissions and the abort-signal reason, with beginAbort/signalAbort still restricted so a late cancellation cannot override the closure. The regression script links the real modules (runtime/drive/tools.ts, runtime/drive/tool-placement.ts, runtime/progress.ts, runtime/types.ts, execution/tools.ts, execution/effect-gate.ts, hooks.ts, session/values.ts, session/commit.ts, session/types.ts) through subject.mjs createGraph, faking only the pi-ai validator, chord context helpers, telemetry span factory, session invariant error type and an in-memory Lane/Session, and asserts observable behaviour across those boundaries: closing an aborting gate (raw gate and real Drive.closeGate) makes the terminal error authoritative and survives a late cancellation; a real HookRegistry after-tool hook clears isError on the durable transcript while still observing the raw error; finalizeToolCall applies explicit false/empty patches and preserves usage; a durable batch with one safe/safe and one unsafe effect_pending call replays only the safe call with its persisted args/memos (checkpoint dropped first) and interrupts the unsafe call with checkpoint details and usage intact, advancing to checkpoint; a parallel batch cancelled after the first admission does not replay the second safe call; a tool running when the gate closes fails the procedure with the terminal fault rather than the pending cancellation. Determinism: no real time, randomness or network as evidence; asynchronous ordering is controlled with promises (deferred resolvers, no timers). Each production file was individually restored to its faulty baseline and the script failed with a real node:assert/strict assertion (exit 1, no crash/import error/timeout): 'the safe/safe replay reruns exactly once with the persisted arguments and memos', 'the hook clears isError on the durable transcript', 'closing an aborting gate still signals admitted work'; the repaired tree passes in about 0.1s. Limitation: the repository's vitest suites under packages/agent/test were not run because no node_modules are installed in this workspace and dependency installation is out of scope; no other validation dependency was needed.
